evidence.detail: Template has Archetype Tree, Decks, Cards, history chart, and Matchups sections — no People section
archetype() controller loads archetypes, matchups, seasons_active, and season_stats — does not load people data
_arch_person_stats preaggregate exists with archetype_id, person_id, season_id, wins, losses, draws, num_decks — the data is ready to query

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Add a load_people_for_archetype(archetype_id, season_id, tournament_only) function in decksite/data/archetype.py (or decksite/data/person.py) that queries _arch_person_stats joined with the person table, ~20 lines. 2) Call it in decksite/controllers/metagame.py archetype() and pass the result to the view. 3) Accept it in Archetype.__init__ (decksite/views/archetype.py) and set self.people. 4) Add a People section to decksite/templates/archetype.mustache using the existing livedecktable pattern adapted for people.
triage.notes: The issue comment suggests extending the same feature to the card detail page; that would be a separate change of similar scope. The preaggregate already tracks per-person per-archetype stats so no schema or data migration is needed.
